text: Transcribed the 48:31 Zoom narration locally with faster-whisper (no API, 152 segments, commit e3a1a25) and extracted feedback/2026-08-25-direction-notes.md. Major creative development: the reversal — the banquet betrayal restaged as a Gothic operation they anticipated, which may invalidate existing STZ03 humiliation frames. OpenAI credits restored and verified on both chat and images endpoints; gpt-image-2 confirmed working. Corrected two errors in STATE.md: cloud never called the .m4a broken (it reported valid AAC and said transcription would work), and transcription never required OpenAI credits.

Measured the music. Reference track is 103.4 BPM not ~92 — patched the wrong number out of music-analysis.md (3 places) and SONG-ARC. The two inbox tracks are parallel keys (Eb minor / Eb major, same tonic) so they intercut without a key change. Added mind/LEARNED.md as an append-only ledger for corrections that change how a node acts, with a required 'How' field, because three times tonight an unverified claim was inherited as fact and cost real work.
